body:
We are still seeing the following critical vulnerabilities in the latest 1.30.4 Temporal images from our scan results:

- temporalio/server:1.30.4
    - CVE-2026-33815
    - CVE-2026-33816
- temporalio/admin-tools:1.30.4
    - CVE-2026-33815
    - CVE-2026-33816
    - CVE-2026-33186

These are the remaining critical findings in our current scan. Can you confirm whether the team is aware of these vulnerabilities and whether there is a plan or ETA for patched images?

comments.body:
\+ 1

Isn't https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p77j-4mvh-x3m3 present in server and ui too ?

EDIT : my bad, that's actually 33816 in server, not 33186. That's how you said ;)
Hello. PGX is the most critical for exposure and must be patched. I see that 5.9.2 is used on main since 2 days, so I conclude it's a matter of time before we might see 1.30.5 pop out of existence.
We have released v1.30.4.1 with this security patch.

title: Critical CVEs still present in temporalio/server:1.30.4 and temporalio/admin-tools:1.30.4
